decisions.reason: The decision places an optional tipping action in the success modal but does not change when mint-success feedback appears or which token ID it displays.
A separate optional tip transaction does not change fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, holdings, access paths, or confirmation-email contents.
The source decision concerns optional post-mint tipping and does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion flow, supported payment methods, or deferred lifecycle.
The optional tip is a separate transaction and does not alter the $15 mint price or allocation of primary-sale revenue.
The optional post-success tip action does not change USDC approval, payment, or NFT-mint execution behavior.
The source does not change ETH-funded mint execution; it only selects how an optional tip is initiated after mint success.
The separate tip transaction does not change the exact-output ETH swap, shortfall behavior, or refund of unspent ETH.
An optional post-mint tip button is not a mint payment-method choice and does not change ETH, USDC, or Card option presentation.
The client selected tipping interaction behavior but did not request any corresponding change to the product FAQ copy.
The success-modal tipping interaction does not change certificate delivery, certificate contents, ebook access, or download links.
The accepted proposal's manual finalization concerns no-code random referrals, while this Requirement governs automatic commission payment when a specific referral code is used.
The optional tipping transaction does not necessarily change any existing About-page copy or content structure.
